name: PostNitro
description:
The PostNitro MCP server lets AI assistants and agents — Claude (Desktop, Code, and Cowork), Cursor, ChatGPT, and any other Model Context Protocol  client — create carousels and image posts, manage brand kits and connected social accounts, and schedule posts directly. 

Instead of writing REST API calls, you connect the server once and your AI assistant gets ready-made tools covering carousel and image generation, brands, social accounts, and scheduling — using the same Embed API key and credits as the REST API.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PostNitro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PostNitro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.postnitro.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PostNitro MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PostNitro lists 35 MCP tools, including postnitro_check_status, postnitro_create_brand, postnitro_create_scheduled_post, postnitro_delete_audio, postnitro_delete_scheduled_post, postnitro_disconnect_social_account, postnitro_generate_and_schedule, postnitro_generate_and_wait, postnitro_generate_carousel, postnitro_generate_image, postnitro_generate_image_and_wait, and postnitro_generate_video.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PostNitro?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PostNitro in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
PostNitro requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PostNitro is developed by PostNitro Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
